title: ELECTROMAGNETIC FIELDS AND WAVES
description: Analyze static and quasi-static electric and magnetic field problems.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (MTH 255 or 255H) and (PH 213 or 213H) and (ENGR 202* or ECE 202*).
* May be taken concurrently.
A minimum grade of C is required in MTH 255, MTH 255H, PH 213, PH 213H, ENGR 202 and ECE 202.
meeting_html: R 4pm-5:50pm in DEAR 208 - Dearborn Hall 208 (9/23 to 12/4)
